qe: Who founded the Haryanka dynasty of Magadha with its capital at Rajagriha (Girivraj), and was a contemporary of both Gautama Buddha and Mahavira?
qh: मगध के हर्यंक वंश का संस्थापक कौन था, जिसकी राजधानी राजगृह (गिरिव्रज) थी तथा जो गौतम बुद्ध तथा महावीर दोनों का समकालीन था?
e: Bimbisara ko unke doosre naam Seniya ya Sreniya se bhi jaana jaata hai; unhone Magadha me Haryanka vansh ki sthapna ki aur Rajagriha (Girivraj) ko rajdhani banaya. Woh Gautam Buddha tatha Mahavira dono ke samkalin the, isliye unka naam bharat ke dharmik itihas me bahut aata hai. Bimbisara ne Anga rajya ko jita aur apne putra Ajatashatru ko wahan ka rajyapal banaya; unhone Rajagriha ke aas-paas pahaadiyon aur nadiyon ka upyog karke Magadha ki sainya-shakti badhai. Magadha ka itihas isi vansh se shuru hota hai, isliye Bimbisara ko Magadha samrajya ka asli neev-daale kehte hain. Ajatashatru unke hi putra the, Udayin unke potra aur Pataliputra ko rajdhani banane wale the, tatha Mahapadma Nanda bahut baad me Nanda vansh ke shasak hue. Exam point: Haryanka vansh ka sansthapak = Bimbisara (Seniya/Sreniya), rajdhani Rajagriha (Girivraj), samkalin - Buddha aur Mahavira.

qe: Which two war machines, 'Mahashilakantaka' and 'Rathamusala', were used by Ajatashatru against the Vajji confederacy?
qh: अजातशत्रु ने वज्जि संघ के विरुद्ध किन दो युद्ध-यंत्रों का प्रयोग किया, जिनके नाम 'महाशिलाकांतक' तथा 'रथमुसल' थे?
oe: A huge stone-hurling catapult and a chariot fitted with swinging maces
A wooden bridge and a water-clock
An iron plough and a horse-drawn drill
A battering ram and a flame thrower
oh: विशाल पत्थर फेंकने वाली गुलेल तथा झूलते मुसलों से युक्त रथ
लोहे का हल तथा घोड़ों से खिंचने वाला बीज-यंत्र
दीवार तोड़ने वाला यंत्र तथा ज्वाला फेंकने वाला यंत्र
e: Ajatashatru ne apne pita Bimbisara ko hatakar Magadha ki satta sanbhaali. Magadha ke uttar me Vajji sangh (jiski rajdhani Vaishali thi) ek ganatantrik (republic-type) sangh tha jisme kai khand milkar shasan karte the; usse jeetna mushkil tha kyunki faisle sabhi sadasya milkar lete the. Is sangh ko harane ke liye Ajatashatru ne do khaas hathiyaar banwaye - 'Mahashilakantaka', ek vishal yantra jo bade patthar phenkta tha, aur 'Rathamusala', aisa rath jisme musal (mace) lage hote the jo chalte samay charon taraf ghoom kar nuksaan karte the. Isi ke saath unhone Vaishali ke paas ek sthal par kile jaisa morcha bana kar lambi gheraabandi ki; us sthal ko 'Jarasanand ka garh' (aaj Rajgir-Bihar Sharif ke beech) bataya jaata hai. Aakhir me Vajji sangh bid gaya tatha Magadha ka vistar uttar ki taraf ho gaya. Wooden bridge, water clock, plough, battering ram wale baki vikalp yuddh-yantron ke bhinn udaharan hain, isliye woh sahi nahi. Exam point: Mahashilakantaka (pathar phenkne wala yantra) aur Rathamusala (musal-wala rath) ka prayog Ajatashatru ne Vajji sangh ke khilaf kiya; Ajatashatru ka doosra naam Kunika tha tatha unhone pratham Buddhist sangiti ko sanrakshan diya.

qe: Which Magadha ruler shifted the capital from Rajagriha to Pataliputra, at the confluence of the Ganga and the Son?
qh: किस मगध शासक ने राजधानी को राजगृह से गंगा तथा सोन के संगम पर स्थित पाटलिपुत्र में स्थानांतरित किया?
e: Udayin (jinka doosra naam Udayabhadra tha) ne Magadha ki rajdhani Rajagriha se hata kar Pataliputra (aaj ka Patna) banai. Unhone yah sthan isliye chuna kyunki yahan Ganga tatha Son nadiyan milti hain; nadiyon ka sangam hone se jald-vyapar (water trade), suraksha aur kheti tino ka laabh ek saath milta tha. Isi karan unhe 'Pataliputra ke sansthapak' tatha 'Magadha ke nadiya prabhutva ke janak' kaha jaata hai. Baad me Maurya tatha Gupta kaal me Pataliputra poore bharat ka sabse bada rajnitik tatha buddhi-jeevi kendra ban gaya; Megasthenes, jo yunanee dutak the, ne bhi is shahar ka varnan kiya. Ashoka Maurya vansh ke samrat the jabki Pataliputra Udayin se pehle rajdhani nahi thi; isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi hai. Bimbisara ki rajdhani sirf Rajagriha thi. Exam point: rajdhani Rajagriha se Pataliputra = Udayin, Ganga-Son sangam ke karan; aage Pataliputra Maurya-Gupta kaal ki rajdhani rahi.

qe: Which Nanda ruler is known by the title 'Sarva-Kshatrantaka' and is regarded as the first historical empire-builder of India?
qh: कौन-सा नन्द शासक 'सर्व-क्षत्रांतक' उपाधि से जाना जाता है तथा भारत के प्रथम ऐतिहासिक साम्राज्य-निर्माता माने जाते हैं?
e: Mahapadma Nanda ko 'Sarva-Kshatrantaka' (sabhi kshatriyon ka ant karne wala) tatha 'Ekarat' (ek hi shasan-karta) jaise khitab mile. Unhone purane kshatriya raajvanshon ko hata kar Magadha me ek bade samrajya ki neev rakhi, isliye unhe bharat ka pehla aitihasik samrajya-nirmata maana jaata hai. Nanda vansh ki sena bahut badi thi aur unhone Ganga ghati ke bade hisse par shasan kiya; isi samrajya ki daulat aur sena ke aadhaar par aage Maurya samrajya ka vistar hua. Panini tatha dharmgranthon me 'Nanda' ka jikra milta hai tatha Jain tatha Buddhist granthon me Nanda vansh ke naam aate hain. Dhana Nanda isi vansh ka aakhri shasak tha, jise Chandragupta Maurya ne hara kar Maurya samrajya sthapit kiya; isliye Dhana Nanda 'first' nahi kehlate. Bimbisara Haryanka vansh ke sansthapak the. Exam point: 'Sarva-Kshatrantaka' tatha 'Ekarat' = Mahapadma Nanda; Nanda vansh ka ant Chandragupta Maurya ne Dhana Nanda ko harakar kiya.

qe: Which Greek ambassador lived in the Mauryan capital Pataliputra and wrote the account 'Indica'?
qh: कौन-सा यूनानी राजदूत मौर्य राजधानी पाटलिपुत्र में रहा तथा 'इंडिका' नामक विवरण लिखा?
e: Chandragupta Maurya ne 303 ee. poo. ke aas-paas Seleucus Nicator (Alexander ke baad Syria tatha Iran ka yunanee shasak) ko hara kar ek sandhi ki; is sandhi ke hisse ke roop me unhe ek yunanee duta apni rajdhani Pataliputra me rakhne ka mauka mila. Wahi duta Megasthenes tha, jisne Pataliputra tatha Maurya prashasan ke apne anubhavon ke aadhaar par 'Indica' naam ki pustak likhi. Isi pustak se hume pata chalta hai ki Pataliputra ke aas-paas lakdi ka bada parkot (rampart), khai tatha 570 burj the, tatha prashasan me 'sachiv', 'amatyas', 'nagar-adhyaksha' jaise adhikari the. Seleucus khud shasak the, isliye 'dutak' nahi; Kautilya/Chanakya Chandragupta ke mantri tatha 'Arthashastra' ke lekhak the; Dionysius ek anya yunanee lekhar the. Exam point: 'Indica' ke lekhak = Megasthenes (Seleucus Nicator ke duta), Chandragupta Maurya ne Seleucus ko 303 BCE ke aas-paas hara kar sandhi ki; Arthashastra ke lekhak = Kautilya.

qe: The Barabar caves, the oldest surviving rock-cut caves in India, were gifted by Emperor Ashoka to which religious sect?
qh: भारत की प्राचीनतम विद्यमान शैलकृत गुफाएँ बराबर की गुफाएँ सम्राट अशोक ने किस धार्मिक संप्रदाय को दान की थीं?
e: Barabar hills (Makhdumpur block, Jehanabad jila, Phalgu nadi ke nikat) me chaar mukhya gufayein hain - Lomas Rishi, Sudama, Visvakarma tatha Karna Chaupar. Inhe Mauryan samrat Ashoka ne apne shasan ke 12vein tatha 19vein varsh me banwaya tatha 'Ajivika' sampraday ke tapasviyon ko daan kiya; unke potra Dasharatha ne aage Nagarjuni pahaadi ki gufayein (Gopi, Vadathika tatha Vapiyaka) isi parampara ko arpit ki. Yeh gufayein eenton se nahi balki ek hi thos granite chattan ko bheetar se khod kar banayi gayi hain, isliye yeh bharat ki rock-cut architecture ki janm-datri maani jaati hain. Inme Lomas Rishi gufa ka hathi-mukhi darwaze ka frieze tatha Maurya kaal ki darpan-jaisi polish buri tarah jaani jaati hai. Yahi kala aage Ajanta, Ellora tatha Karle ki gufaon me viksit hui. Isliye 'Ajivika' hi sahi uttar hai; Mahayana, Svetambara tatha Kapalika sampraday baad ke daur ke nahi kehlate. Exam point: Barabar gufayein = Jehanabad, Ashoka dwara Ajivika sampraday ko daan, Lomas Rishi gufa ka frieze; Dasharatha dwara banwayi Nagarjuni gufayein.

qe: The First Buddhist Council was held at Rajgriha under the patronage of Ajatashatru, while the Second Buddhist Council was held at which place?
qh: प्रथम बौद्ध संगीति अजातशत्रु के संरक्षण में राजगृह में हुई, तो द्वितीय बौद्ध संगीति कहाँ हुई?
e: Gautam Buddha ke Mahaparinirvana (lagbhag 483 ee. poo.) ke baad unke updeshon ko surakshit rakhne ke liye pratham Buddhist sangiti Rajgriha me Sattapanni gufa me hui; iski adhyakshta Mahakassapa ne ki tatha raja Ajatashatru ne sanrakshan diya. Isi sangiti me Buddha ke updesh teen pitakon me baante gaye - Vinaya Pitaka (bhikshuon ke niyam), Sutta Pitaka (updesh) tatha Abhidhamma Pitaka (gahra darshan). Lagbhag sau saal baad Vaishali me doosri sangiti hui, jiski adhyakshta Vasupala tatha Revata ki sahayata se Yasa ne ki; iske sanrakshak raja Kalashoka the. Is sangiti ka mukhya kaaran Vajji ke bhikshuon dwara 'das vastukathayein' (jaise sona-chandi rakhna, do waqt khana) ke roop me dhile niyam apnana tha, jise purava bhikshuon ne mana kar diya. Pataliputra me teesri sangiti Ashoka ke samay me hui (lagbhag 250 ee. poo.), jabki Kushinagar Buddha ke Mahaparinirvana ka sthal hai, sangiti ka nahi. Exam point: Pratham sangiti = Rajgriha (Ajatashatru ke samay, Sattapanni gufa), Dwitiya = Vaishali (Kalashoka ke samay), Tritiya = Pataliputra (Ashoka ke samay).

qe: Vaishali, the capital of the Vajji confederacy, is known as the world's first republic and was the home of the famous courtesan:
qh: वज्जि संघ की राजधानी वैशाली विश्व की प्रथम गणतंत्र मानी जाती है तथा प्रसिद्ध नगर-वधू कौन थी?
e: Vaishali (aaj Vaishali jila) Vajji sangh ki rajdhani thi tatha Lichchhavi ganarajya ka mukhya kendra. Yahan raja ko vansh-parampara nahi balki chunav tatha sabha ke faislon se niyukt kiya jaata tha, isliye ise duniya ka pehla ganatantra (republic) maana jaata hai. Yahan ki rajkiya vyavastha me 'gana' aur 'sangha' jeise sangathan the jo aaj ke loktantrik system ke puraane udaharan hain. Vaishali ki prasiddh nagar-vadhu (ganika) Amrapali thi, jisne Buddh ke updesh sune tatha baad me bhikkhuni (sanyasin) ban kar dhamma ko apnaya. Vaishali me Bhagwan Mahavira ka janm Kundagrama (Kundalpur) me hua, tatha buddhist parampara me yahin Buddha ne apna aakhri updesh diya aur yahin se unki Mahaparinirvana yatra Kushinagar ke liye shuru hui; Ashoka ka sinha-stambh bhi yahan milta hai tatha doosri sangiti bhi yahin hui. Kamaladevi, Vishakha aur Mahapajapati anya aakhyan-gathaon se jude naam hain, isliye woh sahi vikalp nahi. Exam point: Vaishali = Vajji/Lichchhavi ganarajya ki rajdhani, duniya ka pehla ganatantra; Amrapali yahan ki nagar-vadhu thi, Mahavira ka janm Kundagrama (Vaishali) me; Ashoka stambh tatha dwitiya sangiti bhi yahin.

qe: Which Gupta ruler founded the Nalanda Mahavihara, which was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 2016?
qh: किस गुप्त शासक ने नालंदा महाविहार की स्थापना की, जिसे 2016 में यूनेस्को विश्व धरोहर स्थल घोषित किया गया?
e: Nalanda Mahavihara ki neev 5vein sadi (lagbhag 427 ee.) me Gupta shasak Kumargupta I ne rakhi; unhe Mahendraditya ya Shakraditya bhi kaha jaata hai. Yah vishva ka pehla bada avasiya (residential) antarrashtriya vishwavidyalaya maana jaata hai, jahan 10,000 tak chhatra tatha 2,000 shikshak padhte-padhaate the; China ke traveller Xuanzang (Hiuen Tsang) aur I-tsing ne iska vistrit varnan kiya. Aage Kannauj ke Harshavardhana tatha Pala shasakon ne iska bahut vistar kiya. Hamlaa mein 1193 ee. me Bakhtiyar Khalji ki sena ne Nalanda aur Odantapuri ko ujjar diya, jisse yah gyan-kendra khatam ho gaya. Vartaman Bharat Sharif (Nalanda jila) ke Bada Gaon me iske khandaher mile hain; 2016 me UNESCO ne ise World Heritage Site ghoshit kiya. Samudragupta tatha Chandragupta II Nalanda ke sansthapak nahi maane jaate, isliye woh vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Nalanda ke sansthapak = Kumargupta I (Shakraditya), 2016 me UNESCO World Heritage Site, 1193 ee. me Bakhtiyar Khalji dwara vinash; Xuanzang aur I-tsing ne iska varnan kiya.

qe: The Kesariya Stupa, regarded as the tallest ancient stupa in the world, is located in which district?
qh: विश्व का सबसे ऊँचा प्राचीन स्तूप माना जाने वाला केसरिया स्तूप किस जिले में स्थित है?
e: Kesariya stupa East Champaran jile ke Kesariya me Gandak bassein me sthit hai. Buddhist parampara ke anusaar Bhagwan Buddha ne Vaishali se Kushinagar ki apni aakhri yatra shuru ki thi; Vaishali ke Lichchhavi log unhe chhodne door tak aaye, aur jahan unhe alvida kaha wahan Lichchhaviyon ne unki smriti me ek stupa banwaya - yahi Kesariya stupa hai. Aaj yah lagbhag 104 foot (lagbhag 31.7 meter) uncha hai tatha Bahubali ke mandir ke itihas ke kaaran 'Bihar ka Borobudur' bhi kaha jaata hai. 1934 ke bhaakamp se pehle iski unchai aur bhi zyada maani jaati thi, isliye ise Indonesia ke prasiddh Borobudur se uncha bataya jaata hai. 1998 me ASI ki khudai ke baad yah duniya ke saamne aaya. Muzaffarpur, Bhagalpur tatha Saran me aise koi vishva-prasiddh ancien stupa nahi hai, isliye woh vikalp galat hain. Exam point: Kesariya stupa = East Champaran, duniya ka sabse uncha mana jaane wala ancient stupa (karib 104 foot), Lichchhaviyon dwara Buddha ki smriti me nirmit.
